g.desc: foundation models transformed language and vision yet tabular data workhorse of data science left behind
g.text: Foundation models transformed language and vision,
yet tabular data, the workhorse of data science, was left behind.

g.desc: every table different schema model trained on one rarely transfers introduces UniTabE universal pretraining protocol any table uniformly
g.text: Every table has a different schema, so models don't transfer.
UniTabE processes any table in one uniform way.

g.desc: encodes each cell small module called TabUnit refines table Transformer adapts through text prompts
g.text: TabUnit encodes each cell · Transformer refines the table · text prompts adapt to tasks

g.desc: pretrained thirteen billion Kaggle samples beats XGBoost
g.text: Pretrained on 13B Kaggle samples, UniTabE beats XGBoost across benchmarks.
